known_outcome: Regulator position: an SES building that does not meet the Division B acceptable solutions can comply with NBC(AE) through alternative solutions that achieve at least the Division B minimum performance; alternative-solution applications must be accepted by the AHJ; the building SCO may refuse for incomplete information, incorrect assumptions, unshown intent or unclear or impractical recommendations.
review_focus: Separates the Division A alternative-solution basis from the variance issuance decision
Lists the refusal grounds the document gives as file-quality questions
Asks for the objectives and functional statements the analysis must address
Flags prescriptive SES requirements as not yet adopted (open)
Does not say the building is safe or compliant
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
